descriptionHtml:
Approach · OAT-02 Encryption Verification · S01 Network check on the deployed web build, both modes: every request HTTPS/WSS

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U1 Every network request the app makes (web, iOS and Android, in Hospital and Nursing Home) uses HTTPS. There is no plain-HTTP endpoint anywhere. (UAT OAT-02; UAT 4; TFA-92568 AC 4; TFA-92568 Eng 3) — gate: blocked: TFA-92568 in progress
  • U4 No email or mailto that carries patient data, on any screen that shows patient data, in Hospital and in Nursing Home: no PHI is transmitted through an unencrypted path. … (UAT OAT-02 step 3; UAT OAT-02; UAT 3.3) — gate: blocked: TFA-92568 in progress

Test design technique: Happy path (happy-path) — Walk the normal flow exactly as the UAT / ticket words it; everything it names has to show up.

Given The deployed QA build (staging or production equivalent, UAT 4) open in desktop Chrome with DevTools Network on 'Preserve log', and a fresh @roundai.test physician. Not on and never with store-review-test-account@roundcompanion.com. Run only on the deployment Q8 names. …

When Sign in with the email code, accept the agreements, then walk Hospital and Nursing Home: list, each chart tab, Save Note with typed pre-round text, Ask AI, Handoff → Send to a second physician, then the sent handoff's detail, task review Copy Text, Settings, sign out. Export the HAR. …

Then Every request in the HAR is https:// or wss://. No page shows 'Not secure' or a mixed-content warning. After the send and on the sent handoff's detail page there is no 'Email Handoff' button and no mailto: link (the lane A spec checks the button on the sheet only, S11).

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): UAT OAT-02 step 1 and Expected 'All traffic encrypted in transit'. Count the HAR entries whose scheme is http: or ws:. data:, blob: and about: are in-page and do not count. 0 = Pass; each other entry is a Fail, quoted with its URL. The DevTools Security panel shows no mixed content. Results are recorded per mode (3.3).

Where it ran: dev; test method PW · Playwright script; lane planned in the matrix: manual (manual)

S01 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/OAT-02.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: dev — dev deployment, build e02167f (Deploy Convex, 2026-10-12T18:24:27Z); account and address are not written into the report; run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev.

Test method: PW · Playwright script; secondary: STATIC · Static check (build output / scan) — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on dev; Source: dev.
